rule: nodip v2, declared 8 Nov 2026 before any result (Karan: test it as rigorously as the setups - which features and combinations help most and how they behaved in the sessions before the pick; be very open, we are exploring). PICKS: engines D and ENS, ranks 1-10, bought at the D1 open, sold at the D5 close, 0.35 pp costs, judged on the POOLED picks: a stock-day picked by both engines counts once (its best rank); each engine is also checked on its own. DIP = a close on D1-D4 at least 2% below the D1 open; RUNNER = no dip and the D5 close 5% or more above the D1 open. THREE LISTS from the same search: no-dip (target = the share of picks with no dip), runner (the runner share), money (net % per trade). CONDITIONS, all known at the signal close or the D1 open: for each of the 60 features - its level at the signal close (low third, high third, lower half, upper half; the cut-offs come from the picks of the window the rule is chosen on, never from later ones), its move on the signal day (rose / fell), its move on the session before the pick (rose / fell) and the two together (rose twice, fell twice, turned up, turned down); the stock's own candles into the pick (green / red signal day, a close in the top / bottom third of its range, a gap up / down, a 2% rise / fall, up / down over 3 sessions, two higher / lower closes in a row); the 12 zone measures; the model's rank, both engines picking it, D1's weekday, the market context and the stock's state at the pick, the gap at the D1 open. SEARCH: stage 1 every single condition; stage 2 every pair from different families (a feature's level may pair with its own moves); stage 3 the 150 best earning pairs of each list with one more rank / agreement / weekday / context / gap condition. Per list, the 5,000 best by a quick day-clustered lower bound of its target are tested for every condition earning its place (quick) and the first 60 that pass get the full block bootstrap. A rule QUALIFIES for its list when, on the pooled picks: 25 or more trades a year; its target's excess over all picks of the same days (resampled together) has a 95% interval above 0; net per trade at the D1 open 95% above 0; every condition earns its place on the target (the rule minus the trades its simpler version adds, 95% above 0); net <= 0 in at most 2 of its years; and in each engine on its own the target beats that engine's picks and the net is above 0. Score = the lower 95% bound of the target. CANDIDATES: per list the top 5 qualifiers that are not versions of each other (conditions within, or 70% of the same trades); the 10 best by score are listed too, qualified or not. Plain 95% per rule (be very open): the whole search is replayed year by year 2022-2026 (chosen with the picks whose D5 exit was before 1 January - the cut-offs too - and judged on that year); per list HOLDS when the chosen rules' target beats all picks out of sample (95%), WORSE when below, else NOT SHOWN. MONEY, apples to apples: Rs 5 L in 2 / 3 / 5 / 7 equal slots, profits reinvested, no MTF and MTF 2x, entries from 2022, one position per pick, the same open by the model's rank: the baseline (each engine's ranks 1-3 at the D1 open) against each list's arm OUT OF SAMPLE (each year the rules chosen from the years before), the arm in-sample (the candidates) and the out-of-sample arm with S3 in its zone (the newest ZONES run; in-sample). ENTRIES: the D1 open against the breakout, the D2 open after a strong D1 and the D1 close after a strong D1, on the same picks.
